name: Hrusice (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and yellow in the ratio 2:1:1, with a white arrow-shaped charge with a forked base in the red stripe near the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 5 October 2004 (decision No. 45) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
